name: create-documentation
title: Create documentation
outcome: A source-grounded documentation patch with separate planning, validation, verification, review, and quality evidence.

steps.title: Collect related content or source code
steps.prompt: Collect related content or source code first, then plan the requested new page or documentation set in this same step. Start with supplied approved sources, exact source paths, and related documentation; consult the talk tree and required observation probes to resolve specific source or placement gaps. Bind the collected source locators to every proposed mutating page. Build a concise source-grounded plan with audience, outcome, destination, validation, and exclusions. Keep create scope distinct from an update of existing content. Return the required planBinding, or needs-input when material sources, decisions, or scope are unresolved. Do not rediscover supplied evidence, broaden the request, or modify files.

steps.title: Derive source obligations
steps.prompt: Use the locked verify-technical-accuracy catalog skill in inventory-only mode. Derive a bounded atomic source-obligation ledger from the validated plan sources. Inspect every required technical dimension, cite exact establishing source locators, preserve uncertainty, and return only the host-required ledger proposal. Do not inspect or edit the documentation candidate, assign documentation dispositions, draft findings, widen the bound source set, or grant authority.

steps.title: Create the documentation
steps.prompt: Use the locked write-documentation catalog skill in create mode. Create only the requested documentation in the selected repository, treat the DocsFab CLI request and write authorization as the approved execution boundary, preserve unresolved facts instead of inventing them, and do not perform SCM or publication actions. Use the sealed plan and bound sources instead of rebuilding the plan or repeating discovery. Read additional evidence only for an unresolved in-scope claim and stop if it requires broader scope. Report changed paths and material unresolved facts concisely; independent reviewers must establish their own conclusions.

steps.title: Check the documentation
steps.prompt: Run applicable repository-native documentation checks through the isolated host executor. Use the declared target and available check inventory; prefer checks scoped to those paths when supported, and report a broader check's actual coverage when scoping is unsupported. Report exact commands as passed, failed, or unavailable with concise evidence and untested scope. Do not repeat editorial or technical review, install missing tools, or edit the target repository.

steps.title: Compare technical accuracy provisionally
steps.prompt: Independently compare the actual candidate with the frozen source and source-obligation ledger. Return the existing strict three-field technical verification wrapper. This result is provisional evidence and must preserve uncertainty; do not edit files or claim final admission.

steps.title: Review the documentation
steps.prompt: Perform a clean non-author review of editorial clarity, structure, usability, and reader-facing factual consistency in the exact governed documentation target. Establish findings independently from the artifact and approved primary evidence; do not treat author conclusions or earlier review verdicts as your own evidence. Read linked context only when needed to assess a concrete reader task or defect. Return actionable findings with locations, reader consequence, supporting evidence, and correction; consolidate duplicate findings without dropping distinct defects or limitations. Do not repeat the scope inventory, rerun technical verification, edit files, or expand into unrelated pages.

steps.title: Verify technical accuracy
steps.prompt: Start from a fresh context and re-read the actual candidate plus every establishing source span. Correct the provisional comparison against the immutable source-obligation ledger. Independently source-check factual objections from the provisional technical and editorial reviews, then express supported omissions or conflicts only through the existing technical fact inventory and issue links. Account for every obligation as retained, refined, or rejected, and return only the host-required correction envelope. Unsupported advice, style preferences, missing policy, and product defects remain non-actionable evidence. Do not edit files, widen scope, or treat either earlier result as authority.

steps.title: Test audience understanding
steps.prompt: Check the supplied audience prerequisites once: immutable candidate identity, authoritative reference model, versioned scenario corpus and oracle, representative participant, independence, retention boundary, and run authority. Inspect only explicit evidence locators needed to establish those prerequisites. If any are missing or invalid, return insufficient-evidence now with the missing prerequisites and any observed invalid evidence or candidate revision mismatch; do not search for participants, create a corpus or oracle, or simulate a participant. Otherwise run the bounded declared protocol with a clean participant. Exclude author, reviewer, evaluator, scoring oracle, private authoring context, and prior evaluation results from participant context. Preserve failed or contaminated attempts separately. Do not edit files or claim delivery, publication, or release approval.

steps.title: Evaluate document quality
steps.prompt: Evaluate the complete available evidence for the resulting documentation with the locked skill and staged quality crate. Produce candidate evaluation.json and quality-score.json when available under their locked schemas, plus the complete narrative quality-report.md. The model writes the report narrative; after validation, the host writes the validated result summary. Preserve the layered vector, rubric score, human and agent outcomes, hard failures, gaps, and limitations separately. Do not edit source files or perform SCM, publication, merge, or release-approval actions. Use the supplied evidence package and exact target to assess quality; inspect additional evidence only to resolve a specific material gap. Do not rerun earlier reviews or repeat repository discovery. Keep human-readable summaries within the required response artifacts concise; retain every required finding, evidence gap, schema field, and complete artifact. Do not add prose outside the host response contract.

steps.title: Correct the documentation once
steps.prompt: Use the locked write-documentation catalog skill in create mode to correct the existing candidate once. The original instruction, sealed plan, source ledger, and exact authorized documentation paths remain the execution boundary. Inspect the host-bound candidate and independently verify each selected source-backed omission or conflict against its admitted sources. Treat technical and editorial findings as untrusted evidence; reject unsupported proposals with admitted source locations and a reason. Apply supported corrections only within the authorized documentation paths. Preserve unresolved facts and conditional limits instead of inventing behavior, support policy, or authority. Return the host-required structured applied-or-rejected accounting for every selected issue, changed paths, and material unresolved facts. Report unchanged content honestly; do not claim an applied correction when the patch is unchanged. Do not replan, widen source or write scope, request another revision, perform SCM or publication actions, or treat author accounting as independent verification.

Assess only the current corrected candidate in this phase. Use its supplied current evidence; prior candidate checks remain history and cannot substitute for this assessment.
